This editorial illustration features a red background with black and white drawings. In the upper center, the word "TEMPO" is printed in large black capital letters. Above it, text reads "REPORTASE DARI PARIS: TEROR CHARLIE HEBDO" and "PERMAINAN IZIN REGULATOR PENERBANGAN". Below "TEMPO" is "12-18 JANUARI 2015". To the right, white text reads "MENGAPA PILIH BUDI GUNAWAN".

On the left, a figure in a black police uniform with silver-rimmed buttons and a peaked cap stands facing forward. Their face is obscured by a white square frame held up by a person in the center. The frame contains a black-and-white portrait of a man's face with a mustache. The person in the center is depicted in silhouette with dark hair, wearing a red and white patterned shirt. Their right hand holds the portrait frame over the officer's face, while their left arm holds several more white square frames. On the far right, a man in a white shirt is shown in profile, looking towards the center. The lower left corner contains a barcode and text: "RP 39.500", "WWW.TEMPO.CO", and "ISSN: 0126-4273".
